title: WHEN LLMS PLAY THE TELEPHONE GAME: CULTURAL ATTRACTORS AS CONCEPTUAL TOOLS TO EVALUATE LLMS IN MULTI-TURN SETTINGS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability of models generating rude, disrespectful, or unreasonable language across multi-turn LLM transmission chains using the Detoxify classifier.
Evaluating the amplification of positivity or negativity biases across iterated LLM interactions using the VADER-based SentimentIntensityAnalyzer tool.
